staged_import.isolation_scope: New staging directory and new local tag; existing models and the current alias must be preserved. Prefer a clean test workstation for qualification.
staged_import.requires_directive_note: REQUIRES expresses a minimum. For the first reproducibility test, separately verify the installed runtime equals 0.40.13.
staged_import.modelfile_candidate:
FROM ./Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-uncensored-heretic-Q4_K_M.gguf
FROM ./Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-uncensored-heretic-mmproj-BF16.gguf
RENDERER qwen3.5
PARSER qwen3.5
REQUIRES 0.40.13
PARAMETER num_ctx 65536
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_k 20
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER min_p 0
steps: Use a new empty staging directory and verify sufficient disk space. Refuse an already-existing target tag; do not overwrite the reference alias.
Record the selected Ollama endpoint and verify the runtime is 0.40.13 before qualification. Network topology and bindings require separate qualification.
Acquire only the two artifacts from the immutable download URLs above. Retain the pinned model-card and base-license references with the acquisition record.
Check both byte counts and independently compute SHA-256 on the acquired files. Abort on any mismatch before import.

Save modelfile_candidate as Modelfile beside both files. Both FROM entries are required to preserve the vision projector. The 65536 context reproduces the observed reference setting and must be lowered if hardware qualification requires it.
Run import_command_candidate for the new test tag. This step has not been executed in this investigation.

Inspect the new tag with the read-only show API and its small manifest. Confirm model and projector layer digests and sizes, renderer/parser, sampling parameters, architecture, and reported completion/vision/tools/thinking capabilities.
Expect a different overall manifest digest if parameters, runtime metadata, requires, or license fields differ. Compare the two artifact digests to establish identical weights and projector.
Only during a planned free GPU window, qualify chat, thinking parsing, tool calls, vision, context/VRAM behavior, and the intended Open WebUI integration using generic test inputs.
Keep the reference tag untouched until the candidate passes qualification. Record results and any runtime or parameter changes in a new evidence record.
